conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Special Investigator Raymond speaking. Are you Mr. Patel?
Yes, this is Ajay Patel. I received a message to call this number urgently. Is something wrong?

Yes, Mr. Patel. We are contacting you regarding a discrepancy in your federal tax filings for the years 2020 through 2022. Our records indicate an outstanding tax liability combined with unreported income.
I'm not sure what you mean. I file my taxes every year. Can you please explain?

According to our audit, you underreported your income by approximately $18,000 each year, resulting in unpaid taxes, interest, and penalties totaling $12,475.63. This is a federal issue, and it's quite serious.
Oh my god, I had no idea. I always use the online tax software. Is there a way to check? Will this affect my visa?

If you fail to resolve this immediately, your case will be referred to the Department of Homeland Security, which could jeopardize your residency status. You may also face bank account levies and property liens within 24 hours.
Please, I cannot lose my visa. I will do anything to fix this. How can I see the details or appeal?

Mr. Patel, this is now classified as a federal fraud investigation. You are not eligible for appeal until the outstanding balance is cleared. If you do not comply, an arrest warrant will be issued under your name.
Arrest? Sir, I can't be arrested. What do I need to do? I don't have that much money.
At this stage, the IRS only accepts payment to settle the allegations and prevent escalation. We can accept an immediate partial payment of $6,000 to pause further actions.
Six thousand? I don't have that in my account. Can I pay with my credit card or something?

We do not accept direct card payments over the phone. However, the IRS has authorized settlement via wire transfer, cryptocurrency, or government-approved electronic gift cards. Which method can you arrange in the next thirty minutes?
I think I can get some gift cards from the store, but is this really the IRS procedure? I've never heard about this.
This is a standard expedited protocol for urgent tax enforcement cases. If you fail to comply, your driver's license and bank accounts will be frozen today. Please confirm you understand.
Yes, I understand. Should I go to the store right now?

Yes, Mr. Patel. Remain on the line. Purchase six Apple or Target gift cards, each for $500. Once you have them, provide the redemption codes directly to me so we can submit to the Treasury Department.
Okay, I will go. Please don't call the police. I am very scared.
As long as you cooperate and complete payment within the hour, no legal action will be initiated. Do not hang up or place this call on hold at any point.
I'm leaving for the store now. Should I get Apple gift cards or Target? Does it matter?
Apple gift cards are preferred, but Target is also accepted. Ensure each card is for $500 and keep the receipts. Notify me immediately when you have completed the purchase.
